message: 声
There exist countless words to refer to the Lord.
Not only among my brethren, but even among the lowly Demons and frail humans.
Yet no word can possibly describe Him without excess or deficiency.
Compared to the Lord's perfection, even my brethren are imperfect.
An imperfect being cannot explain a perfect being beyond a vague concept.
Therefore, I possess no words to accurately describe what happened to me that night.
That night. The night I could not sleep due to the discomfort of the defiled flesh I wore.
After tossing and turning endlessly, in the instant a thin veil of slumber clouded my consciousness, He appeared.
If I may be permitted to state it with my meager vocabulary, the Lord was pure light.
Though I say light, it was not a visual thing.
My optic nerves certainly perceived light, yet it was not an external stimulus.
Nor was it something emitted from within myself.
If forced to speak with my meager vocabulary, I can only say it came neither from within me nor from outside, but appeared from somewhere and overlapped with my very existence.
Perhaps that was the Lord's gaze.
Perhaps He found me among hundreds of billions of specks of dust and deigned to look upon me.
No, that is impossible.
The Lord does not need to find anything. For all creation in this world lies within the Lord Himself.
Perhaps it was a sign that the time had come for me to act.
No, it is presumptuous to speculate on the Lord's will. I ought to limit myself to stating that I certainly felt something.
The light pierced through me and filled my entire body.
It was nostalgically warm, yet freezing cold.
My heart was shaken with awe.
I understood in an instant that the Lord had appeared.
Was it an instant? Or was it a long time?
Before I knew it, the Lord had departed.
There was no light, and in the darkness of this defiled world, I was alone.
Yet it was no dream.
Revealed to me in that instant was a radiant, shining world.
A world that I, born into a defiled world, have no means to comprehend.
A new, and perfect, world.
And within me was power. A power not my own. An unfathomable power.
A power that would shatter the body and mind of most angels merely by harboring it.
A power for the sake of the new world.
I understood.
The reason I exist here is because I was created to harbor and wield this power, and bring about the new world.
What I, entrusted with this power, had to do was clear.
To realize the Lord's intent.
And the Lord's will was my will as well.
